newsitem.title: USA: Top 10 movies at U.S. box office.
newsitem.headline: Top 10 movies at U.S. box office.

text.p: Following are movie ticket sales at the U.S. box office for the June 27-29 weekend,
according to studio estimates collected by Exhibitor Relations
Co. on Sunday. Final data will be issued on Monday.
4 (2) My Best Friend's Wedding ................ $15.3 million
6 (4) Jurassic Park: The Lost World ........... $4.4 million
7 (5) Speed 2: Cruise Control ................. $3.2 million
NOTE: Last weekend's position in parentheses. * denotes new release.
"Face/Off" is released by Paramont Pictures, a unit of Viacom Inc..
"Hercules" and "Con Air" are released by Walt Disney Co.
"Batman & Robin" is released by Warner Bros, a unit of Time Warner Inc..
"My Best Friend's Wedding" is released by TriStar Pictures, a unit of Sony Corp..
"The Lost World: Jurassic Park" and "Liar Liar" are released by Universal Studios, a unit of Seagram Co. Ltd..
"Speed 2: Cruise Control" is released by 20th Century Fox, a unit of News Corp..
"Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery" is released by New Line Cinema, a unit of Time Warner.
"Ulee's Gold" is released by Orion Pictures, which is in the process of being acquired by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Inc., a studio owned by investor Kirk Kerkorian and Australia's Seven Network Ltd..
